Marcy — thanks for the export and for the questions. Short answers first, then a suggested playbook.

1) PO matching: the single most reliable field is an explicit PO number in the invoice metadata (header line). We support these match places in priority order:
- invoice metadata header: PO: 12345 (preferred)
- invoice filename: includes PO_12345 (good)
- subject line token: PO=12345 (acceptable but lower match confidence)

2) Email fallback: yes, we support an email fallback to ap-invoices@redwood.com with an idempotency token. Please include either a line in the email body: "Redwood-Ack: <vendor-token>" or embed the token in the filename for attachments (eg invoice_PO12345_ACK98765.pdf). Without a token we rely on filename+PO+amount matching which increases manual exceptions.

Suggested onboarding playbook (attached):
- Step A: Send one sample invoice via portal JSON or CSV to confirm mapping.
- Step B: If portal unavailable, send to ap-invoices@redwood.com with header "Redwood-Ack: <token>" and filename convention PO_##_INV_YYYYMMDD.pdf
- Step C: After first live invoice, we'll run a 48-hour reconcile and share exception CSV.

I've attached a suggested CSV template for your export and a PO crosswalk. Ben, Karthik — looping you in for SLA/PO-stamping questions.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Marcy — sounds good. Final plan and SLA below: 

Pilot plan (two-week email-fallback pilot)
- Send nightly CSV to ap-invoices@redwood.com with filename convention: Lumen_PO_Batch_YYYYMMDD_ACK<vendor-token>.csv
- Required CSV columns: invoice_id, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, total_amount_usd, vendor_contact_email, attachment_reference (if PDF included)
- We'll ingest CSV first, then attempt PDF attachment parsing if present.

SLAs and exceptions
- Redwood will process inbound CSVs within 24 hours and post an ack to the vendor-token webhook (or email back if webhook not configured).
- Any unmatched rows will be flagged and vendor will receive a single exceptions CSV at T+48 hours.
- After successful pilot, we will provide a portal token for direct ingestion; we expect portal cutover to reduce exceptions by ~85%.

Next steps
1) Marcy — send one sample CSV tonight with filename including the vendor-token.
2) Karthik/Ben — can you confirm runtime/ingest quota for nightly batches and if we want to enable immediate ACK webhooks or email-only for Lumen?

Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Olga
